verso-admin.description: Session grants for an administrator's login, whose write list names '*' (root's does): every uci config read and written, for config history to show and act on whatever config an apply or a direct edit touched, and rpcd's session list and destroy, for Access to list and end other accounts' sessions. All of it sits under write, so a login that reads '*' but writes less takes none of it: session list answers every session's sid. Verso ships it so an administrator holds these whatever else is installed; a restricted login lists the groups it may use by name and leaves this one out.
